description: Source code for distributed Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) common utilities and data structures, including mesh info classes, training state enum, and tensor handling functions.

classes.name: DataParallelMeshInfo
classes.description: Base class for mesh information in data parallel training, holding a DeviceMesh and optional mesh dimensions.

classes.name: FSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Derived class for FSDP-specific mesh info, requiring a non-None shard_mesh_dim.

classes.name: DDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Derived class for DDP-specific mesh info, requiring a non-None replicate_mesh_dim.

classes.name: HSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Multiple inheritance class combining FSDPMeshInfo and DDPMeshInfo for HSDP mesh info.

classes.name: TrainingState
classes.description: Enum representing different states in the FSDP training process.

methods.name: detect_compiled_autograd
methods.description: Detects if compiled autograd is enabled in torch.

methods.name: compiled_autograd_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether compiled autograd is enabled.

methods.name: _raise_assert_with_print
methods.description: Prints a message with rank info, stack trace, and raises an AssertionError.

methods.name: _is_composable_with_fsdp
methods.description: Checks if a module is compatible with FSDP based on its registry.

methods.name: _get_dim0_padded_size
methods.description: Calculates padded size for tensor dimension 0 based on a factor.

methods.name: _chunk_with_empty
methods.description: Chunks a tensor into specified number of chunks, padding with empty tensors if needed.

methods.name: _get_dim_chunked_size
methods.description: Determines the size of a chunk, preserving zero-sized dims for DTensor APIs.

methods.name: _from_local_no_grad
methods.description: Creates a DTensor from a local tensor without gradient tracking, optimized for eager mode.

methods.name: _to_dtype_if_needed
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a specified dtype if necessary.

methods.name: _cast_fp_tensor
methods.description: Casts a tensor to a specified floating point dtype if needed.

methods.name: is_bw
methods.description: Checks if the current graph task is a backward pass.
